versions.content: Service Name Csm_ Key Set Invalid Syntax Std_ Return Type Csm_ Key Set Invalid ( uint32 key Id ) Service ID [hex] 0x85 Sync/ Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant Parameters (in) key Id Holds the identifier of the key which shall be invalidated. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: Request successful E_ NOT_ OK: Request failed CRYPTO_ E_ BUSY: Request failed, Crypro Driver Object is busy Description Sets the key status to invalid. The key cannot be used any longer for cryptographic operations until it has been set to valid state again. Available via Csm.h
